name: Sparklers
description: The gentlest way to celebrate. Cold-glow and colour sparklers in 7cm to 90cm lengths — the safest first cracker for children and the prettiest for photographs.

name: Flower Pots
description: Ground fountains that throw a steady column of crackling gold. Our deluxe pots run 45–70 seconds with layered colour changes and almost no smoke.

name: Ground Chakkars
description: Classic ground spinners that whirl into a disc of colour. Balanced hubs for a longer, wobble-free spin and a bright colour-shift finish.

name: Rockets
description: Stick and bottle rockets with stabilised flight paths, rising 25–60 metres before opening into colour, crackle or a single deep report.

name: Aerial Shots & Fancy
description: Repeating aerial cakes from 12 to 240 shots. Pre-fused, single-ignition sequences that run a complete choreographed show on their own.

name: Sound Crackers
tagline: For the ones who want the boom
description: Garland chains, atom bombs and deluxe single reports. All within the 125 dB PESO limit, tested batch by batch at our Sivakasi unit.

name: Kids Zone
description: Pop-pops, snake tablets, colour smoke, magic whips and ground novelties. Low-noise, low-flame and endlessly entertaining.

name: Gift Boxes
description: Hand-packed assortment boxes with a printed cracker list inside the lid. The default answer for office gifting and family visits.
